title: Smallest Good Base
description: Find the smallest base k >= 2 such that n written in base k consists only of 1s.
pseudocode:
1. Convert n to integer n_val
2. Iterate m from log2(n) down to 2
3. Binary search for base k in [2, n-1]
4. Check if 1 + k + k^2 + ... + k^(m-1) == n_val
5. Return smallest k found

steps.note: Max possible m is log2(13) which is 3 (for 1+k+k^2 = 13)
Binary search for k for m=3: range [2, 12]
